rules.description: Checks that the percentage of deleted records across the import does not exceed 0.1% (accounts for school closures/mergers across biennial CRDC releases).

Ensures all active JuvenileJusticeFacility and NotJuvenileJusticeFacility StatVars (excluding 2022-only GenderUnknownOrNotStated) within each input split share the same latest observation date (MaxDate).

Verifies that every StatVar in each input split meets its expected latest observation date (2012 for pre-2014 non-JJ StatVars, 2014 for 2014 JJ StatVars, 2016 for the 2016 split, 2022 for GenderUnknownOrNotStated, and >= 2024 for active 2018Onwards StatVars).

params.query: SELECT StatVar, MinDate, MaxDate, CASE WHEN StatVar NOT LIKE '%JuvenileJusticeFacility%' THEN CAST(MaxDate AS INTEGER) >= 2012 WHEN CAST(MinDate AS INTEGER) = 2014 THEN CAST(MaxDate AS INTEGER) >= 2014 WHEN CAST(MinDate AS INTEGER) = 2016 THEN CAST(MaxDate AS INTEGER) >= 2016 WHEN StatVar LIKE '%GenderUnknownOrNotStated%' THEN CAST(MaxDate AS INTEGER) >= 2022 WHEN CAST(MinDate AS INTEGER) >= 2018 THEN CAST(MaxDate AS INTEGER) >= 2024 ELSE FALSE END AS is_fresh FROM stats UNION ALL SELECT 'EMPTY_STATS' AS StatVar, '' AS MinDate, '' AS MaxDate, FALSE AS is_fresh WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM stats WHERE StatVar LIKE '%JuvenileJusticeFacility%')
